privacy.about: Market App is a marketplace application that allows users to discover products, publish listings, communicate with sellers and buyers, save products, and discover products based on location.
privacy.consent: By using Market App, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

intro.title: Your privacy matters
intro.body: This Privacy Policy explains what information Market App collects, how we use it, how we protect it, and the choices you have.

collect.title: 1. Information We Collect
collect.intro: Depending on how you use the application, we may collect the following information.

account.title: 1.1 Account Information
account.intro: When you create an account, we may collect:
account.name: Name
account.note: Passwords are not stored in plain text. Authentication information is handled using appropriate security mechanisms.

product.title: 1.2 Product Information
product.intro: When you publish a product, we may collect:
product.name: Product name
product.coords: Latitude and longitude associated with the listing
product.note: This information is used to display your listing to other users.

location.title: 1.3 Location Information
location.intro: Market App may request access to your device's location when you use location-based features.
location.set: Set the location of a product you are selling
location.permission: Location access is requested only when required by a feature that you choose to use.
location.control: You can control location permissions through your device settings.
location.background: Market App does not require continuous background location tracking for its normal marketplace functionality.
location.personal: Location data is considered personal data and should be disclosed according to the actual location functionality implemented by the application.

messages.title: 1.4 Messages and Conversations
messages.intro: When you use the chat functionality, we process information necessary to provide messaging between users, including:
messages.product: Product information attached to a message, when applicable
messages.note: Messages are used to provide communication between marketplace users.

media.title: 1.5 Images and Media
media.intro: When you upload product images or a profile image, those files may be stored on our servers and displayed to other users according to the functionality of the application.
media.warning: You should avoid uploading personal, confidential, financial, or sensitive information in product images or messages.

notifications.title: 1.6 Notifications
notifications.intro: Market App may process notification-related information to provide notifications such as:
notifications.control: You can control notification permissions through your device settings.

use.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
use.publish: Allow users to publish and manage listings
use.near: Show products near a selected location
use.comm: Enable communication between buyers and sellers
use.likes: Process likes and other marketplace interactions
use.prevent: Detect and prevent misuse of the service
use.improve: Improve the reliability and functionality of the application
use.note: We do not use your personal information for purposes that are incompatible with the purposes described in this Privacy Policy.

shared.title: 3. Information Shared With Other Users
shared.intro: Some information is intentionally visible to other Market App users.
shared.publish: For example, when you publish a product, other users may be able to see:
shared.name: Your public profile name
shared.location: Product location or approximate listing location
shared.messages: Messages you send through the chat feature are shared with the users participating in that conversation.
shared.warning: You should therefore avoid including private or sensitive information in public listings or messages.

providers.title: 4. Service Providers
providers.intro: Market App may use third-party infrastructure and service providers to operate the application, such as:
providers.note: These providers may process information only as necessary to provide their services to the application.
providers.noSell: We do not sell your personal information.

security.title: 5. Data Security
security.intro: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure.
security.noGuarantee: However, no internet-based service can guarantee absolute security.
security.responsibility: You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for notifying us if you believe your account has been compromised.

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.intro: We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to:
retention.note: When information is no longer required, it may be deleted or anonymized, subject to applicable legal and operational requirements.

deletion.title: 7. Account and Data Deletion
deletion.request: You may request deletion of your Market App account and associated personal information.
deletion.process: When an account deletion request is processed, we will delete or anonymize associated personal information where required and where retention is not necessary for legitimate legal or security purposes.
deletion.contact: If account deletion is not yet available directly inside the application, users may contact us using the contact information provided below to request deletion.
deletion.play: Google Play requires apps that support account creation to provide users with a clear way to request account deletion and deletion of associated data.

rights.title: 8. Your Privacy Rights
rights.intro: Depending on the laws applicable to you, you may have rights regarding your personal information, including:
rights.know: The right to know what information is collected
rights.access: The right to access your personal information
rights.correct: The right to correct inaccurate information
rights.delete: The right to request deletion of your information
rights.restrict: The right to restrict certain processing
rights.object: The right to object to certain processing
rights.withdraw: The right to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
rights.gdpr: For users covered by the GDPR, these rights can include access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection, subject to applicable conditions and exceptions.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.intro: Market App is not intended to knowingly collect personal information from children in violation of applicable laws.
children.contact: If you believe that a child has provided personal information without appropriate authorization, please contact us so that we can review and take appropriate action.

cookies.title: 10. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.intro: The Market App mobile application does not intentionally use cookies for advertising purposes.
cookies.tech: Our servers or technical infrastructure may use necessary technologies such as authentication tokens, session information, logs, or similar mechanisms required to operate and secure the service.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.intro: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
changes.date: When changes are made, we will update the Last Updated date at the beginning of this document.
changes.notice: For significant changes, we may provide additional notice through the application or another appropriate communication method.
changes.review: We encourage users to review this Privacy Policy periodically.

contact.title: 12. Contact Us
contact.intro: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, your personal information, or a request to access, correct, or delete your information, please contact us:

acceptance.title: 13. Acceptance
acceptance.intro: By using Market App, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
acceptance.disagree: If you do not agree with this Privacy Policy, please stop using the application.
